question: What Are the Cable Color Codes for Thermocouple Wiring?
body_html:
Cable color codes for field instruments identify each conductor so loops are wired and checked correctly. In ANSI thermocouple wiring the red wire is always the negative lead:

Type (ANSI)PositiveNegative
KYellowRed
JWhiteRed
TBlueRed

Use matching thermocouple extension wire, never mix types, and ground the cable shield at one end only to avoid noise and false readings.
